description: The RFC 7517 A.3 set by alg A128KW fails with MultipleMatchingKeys; decided by ADR 0054 §2.2 (JWK alg): member 0's alg is A128KW, and member 1 has no alg, use or key_ops, so it matches any symmetric alg its oct family serves (§2.1); selection checks no key size (§2, not part of selection), so its 64 octets do not exclude it, and two match (§4); a kid disambiguates; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose

keys.kid: HMAC key used in JWS spec Appendix A.1 example
